grammar_tips.title: Talking about animals: has/have
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'has' for he/she/it and 'have' for I/you/we/they. Example: 'The dog has a tail.' 'We have two cats.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'he/she/it' के लिए 'has' और 'I/you/we/they' के लिए 'have' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: 'The dog has a tail.' 'We have two cats.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: he/she/it には 'has'、I/you/we/they には 'have' を使います。例: 'The dog has a tail.' 'We have two cats.'

grammar_tips.title: Describing animal sounds
grammar_tips.explanation: Different animals make different sounds. Example: 'Dogs bark.' 'Cats meow.' 'Cows moo.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: अलग-अलग जानवर अलग आवाज़ निकालते हैं। उदाहरण: 'Dogs bark.' 'Cats meow.' 'Cows moo.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 動物によって鳴き声が違います。例: 'Dogs bark.' 'Cats meow.' 'Cows moo.'
